why: The terminal is clean (Vite ready, then 'hmr update /src/App.jsx') because the error is at run time, not compile time: the learner wrote const weightKg = '5' and {weightKg.toFixed(1)}, and a string has no toFixed. In the browser the page is blank and DevTools shows 'Uncaught TypeError: weightKg.toFixed is not a function'. The step is the card showing in the browser; it does not.

step.title: Show the fact card in the browser
step.instructions: Save src/App.jsx with the animal card (a div with className="card", the name in an h2 and the weight in a p). With npm run dev still running, check the browser shows the card and the terminal shows no errors.

checks.label: No compile errors in the terminal

common_mistakes: Two root elements side by side; wrap them in one div.
